item.title: Cart Rock Meeting
item.description: The Livingston County Commission will meet in regular session today at 9:30 am in the commission room of the courthouse. The commissioners will handle county road and bridge matters and administrative and departmental responsibilities. At 6:00 pm. the commissioner will attend the Cart Rock meeting at the Celebrations room at 2870 Grand Drive.

item.title: Kansas City Man Arrested In Linn County
item.description: A Kansas City man was arrested by State Troopers in Linn County on Wednesday night. At about 10:45 pm, Troopers arrested 19-year-old Dany A. Cadena of Kansas City, KS, for alleged no valid license and on a Kansas warrant for alleged obstructing police. He was taken to the Macon County Jail with no bond allowed.
